title: Kalyāṇamittam
text: 2. Nāham bhikkhave aññam ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi || yena anuppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo uppajjati || uppanno vā a- a- maggo bhāvanāpāripūrim gacchati || yathayidam bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā || || 3. Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkham a- a- maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto a- amaggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || [page 036] 36 Magga-Saṃyuttam XLV. 4. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la-pe || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāganirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto a- a- maggam bhāveti a- amaggam bahulīkarotī ti || ||
